people.name: Archites
people.line: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn, and earth on his head.
translations.bsb: When David came to the summit, where he used to worship God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him with his robe torn and dust on his head.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
translations.asv: And it came to pass, that, when David was come to the top of the ascent, where God was worshipped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head.
